text:
alex: Heads-up: plan to standardize on `x-route-policy` (structured) and deprecate `x-route-hint`. We need an SDK compatibility plan.
sarah: Agree. Two constraints: console metrics use header as key; private installs may never see gateway rewrites.
tyler: Proposal: gateway normalizer for hosted + SDK-side shim (py/ts/go) defaulting to compat mode. Strict mode opt-in.
mia: Telemetry snag: our sampler parses with split(':'). New JSON will break buckets unless we canonicalize.
devex-liz: Docs and CLI scan required. We'll add `redwood routescan` to find old usages.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: gateway-normalizer canary scheduled 04/05 01:30 UTC.
alex: Rollout steps: 1) deploy gateway normalizer to hosted canary, 2) ship SDK minor with REDWOOD_ROUTE_MODE=compat|strict default=compat, 3) ingest canonical ids before metrics hashing, 4) backfill last 30d metrics to canonical ids.
tyler: SDKs: accept string|object for set_route_policy, warn in compat, throw in strict. Unit tests for old/new formats.
sarah: Console: need alias table by EOD to avoid duplicate series.
mia: Telemetry: we'll run a sampling-join on 14d window and report any distribution drift.
devex-liz: I'll publish migration doc and changelog blurb (48h).
alex: Action items noted. Reconvene tomorrow for signoff. :thumbsup:
